narrative.overview:
The page is the moment a map listing shows an empty, dashed "Add website" button, and what happens after someone presses it. Cool concrete white and near-black ink carry everything; one acid lime is the press, the fill, the "yes". Mona Sans stretched wide gives the headings a confident, built-not-written voice; the same family at normal width reads quietly; Martian Mono labels things the way a listing or a code folder would.

It is a light page with two night sections (the work, then contact and footer), and the header turns dark with them. The signature is the pinned build: a listing becomes a browser window becomes a phone becomes a live address, all drawn in CSS and scaled as one picture. Everything else is a small live demo of a real promise, not a picture of it.
keyCharacteristics: Concrete white ground, white cards, two night bands; lime is a fill only.
Wide display Mona Sans (wdth 106–125%), normal-width body, mono labels at 15px.
Pills for actions, 18–28px rounded cards, hairline borders, almost no shadow.
One pinned, scrubbed story (Find, Build, Show, Launch); every other motion is small and earned.
No business names, no screenshots: the work is nine tiny CSS vignettes of ideas.

rules.name: The Lime Is A Fill Rule
rules.body: Lime is never text on a light ground. It fills a shape outlined or labelled in ink. Anything pressed, ticked, built or live turns lime; nothing decorative does.

rules.name: The Two Nights Rule
rules.body: Night grounds belong to the work and to contact plus footer. New sections are concrete or surface.

rules.name: The 15px Floor Rule
rules.body: No page text is smaller than 15px; mono labels sit exactly at the floor. Only text inside the scaled build picture is exempt, because it is drawn, not read.

rules.name: The Masked Rise Rule
rules.body: Headings arrive word by word out of SplitText line masks (yPercent 110, power4.out, 0.04–0.06s stagger). Masks carry descender padding. No blur reveals.

rules.name: The Desk Objects Rule
rules.body: Only the drawn listing, browser and phone cast shadows. Cards, cells and ticks stay flat. Nothing glows. The header's 14px backdrop blur is the only frost.

dos: **Do** use lime only as a fill outlined or labelled in ink.
**Do** draw the work as small CSS pictures of ideas, paused until hovered or on screen.
**Do** size anything inside the build stage in container units so it scales as one picture.
**Do** run motion through GSAP and ScrollTrigger with Lenis on the ticker (fine pointers only), and refresh after fonts load.
**Do** make every selectable control toggle off on a second tap, and give the pin its scroll-up/down hint.
donts: **Don't** put section kicker labels above headings or numbers on the vignette cards; both were removed on purpose.
**Don't** add glows, halos or shadows on flat cards.
**Don't** show business names, screenshots of pitch sites, personal names, prices or mentions of AI tools.
**Don't** use lime as text on light grounds or as a section ground.
